name: Bogumił Celmer

events.place: Trąbczyn Holendry, Kreis Konin, Kammerdepartment Posen, South Prussia, Kingdom of Prussia

citations.page: Hollendry Łazińskie #58, [unknown page number, after page 349]

citations.text: Marriage from Cholędry of Bogumił Celmer and Rozyna Dorota Godfryd Year Eighteen Hundred Nineteen Day Tenth of November before us Rector of Trąpczyn Civil Servant of Commune Trąpczyn of District Konin in Kalisz Voivodeship showed up Bogumił Celmer of twenty years according to Trąpczyn Church Records with the assistance of His Parents Wojciech and Eleonora nee Roznoro? Celmer the son coming from and living in Cholędry as well as Miss Rozyna Dorota Godfryd of nineteen years according to Twardów Church Records with the assistance of Her Parents Krzysztof and Eleonora nee Grecz Godfryd the daughter coming from [something missing?] Giving away parties demand that the marriage take place by the power whose announcements were made first on day seventeenth of October and second on day twenty/fifth of this [that] month and [this] year and when on the set day the marriage gets valid we did not get and Parents and Relatives allowed the wedding ceremony we got down to read all papers from the Chapter Six about marriage we asked the couple whether they want to become married and they each replied that it is their will We Announce in the name of the Law that Bogumił Celmer and Rozyna Godfryd are married which Account of we wrote in the presence Of witnesses Krzysztof Zayport of fifty years and Kaźmierz Łącki of thirty four years Piotr Celmer of fifty years and Michał Bitner Of thirty five years farmers living in Cholędry after writing down and reading this document hereby signed priest Józef Zurkoski Rector and Civil Servant

notes: In the death of his son Krzysztof (I2790), Bogumil was listed as being 34 years old in 1825, making his date of birth as 1791. This date is about 8 years earlier than the birthdate announced in his wedding to Rozyna Dorota (I1707).
